Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.constants

package frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.constants
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers
     
  • Class
    Description
    ControlConstants
    Proportional Integral Derivative Feedforward, constants for combining PID and Feedforward
    ControlConstants.ControlType
    Which closed-loop control scheme a Controller should use, determining which onboard/software control mode setPosition/setVelocity dispatch to.
    ControllerConstants
    Top-level configuration for a Controller: bundles the real-hardware settings (ControllerConstants.real) used on the robot with the simulated mechanism (ControllerConstants.simSystem) used when running in simulation, so one constants object can build either kind of controller via Controller.createController.
    RealControllerConstants
    Real-hardware configuration for a Controller: motor IDs/inversion/current limits (RealControllerConstants.base), control-loop gains and gear ratio (RealControllerConstants.control), software position limits (RealControllerConstants.softLimits), limit-switch definitions (RealControllerConstants.hardLimits), and an optional CANcoder (RealControllerConstants.canCoder).
    RealControllerConstants.Base
    Motor IDs, inversion, brake/coast mode, current limits, followers, and CAN bus for a controller.
    RealControllerConstants.Base.SimpleControllerConstants
    The CAN ID and inversion setting for a single motor controller (main or follower).
    RealControllerConstants.CANCoder
    Configuration for an optional CTRE CANcoder providing absolute/remote position feedback.
    RealControllerConstants.CANCoder.CANCoderMode
    How a configured CANcoder's absolute position is combined with the motor controller's own encoder; see RealControllerConstants.CANCoder.mode.
    RealControllerConstants.Control
    Closed-loop control gains, gear ratio/conversion, and goal tolerances for a controller.
    RealControllerConstants.HardLimits
    Container for a controller's hard (and virtual) limit switch definitions.
    RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.HardLimit
    The configuration for one hard limit switch - either a real switch wired to a DigitalInput, or a "virtual" one inferred from motor stall current.
    RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.LimitTriggerMethod
    Callback invoked by Controller.periodic() when a RealControllerConstants.HardLimits.HardLimit newly becomes active.
    RealControllerConstants.SoftLimits
    Software-enforced minimum/maximum position limits for a controller, in mechanism units.
